scope.evidence: Only the five live/*/stdout.jsonl receipts and their extracted content

coverage_method.extent: Complete extracted text of all five receipts, excluding HTTP(S) link destinations
coverage_method.representation: JSON content string selected; newline escapes expanded; angle-bracket HTTP(S) destinations replaced; other JSON and Markdown escapes retained
coverage_method.line_reference_basis: One-based lines in the newline-expanded content view, not physical JSONL lines; blank lines retain their line positions
coverage_method.display_truncation_handling: Truncated portions were reread in smaller overlapping windows
coverage_method.measurements: Reader code-unit and tokenizer-issue counts are preserved receipt values, not new live measurements
excluded: HTTP(S) link destinations, including tracking/context values
Base64 response bodies and raw HTML body inspection
Other lane evidence files and code
Linked pages, images, videos, rendered UI, and interactive behavior

summary.critical_gap: Consumer Reports contains background, methodology, and FAQs but not the seven recommended cooktops promised by the title

limitations: Complete inspection of saved text is not proof of complete live-page capture
HTTP 200 and a null challenge barrier do not establish task completion or unrestricted access
Account and form success/error strings do not establish user account state or actions performed
Table associations and actual UI visibility are not verified
Text anomaly origins cannot be attributed to source or extractor from this review alone
Product claims, advice, reviews, measurements, prices, availability, and release dates are neither fact-checked nor endorsed
No live website, socket, real TTY/PTY, SafeJS, or broader browser acceptance gate is established

reviews.disposition: Preserve original partial/unverified receipts. Four demonstrate substantial article/review text; Consumer Reports demonstrates partial prose but not its promised recommendation list. No broader acceptance or source-truth claim.

limitations: Five linked content pages do not establish complete site compatibility or global agent-usage rankings.
Focus and sections intentionally omit source context; publisher claims/prices/dates are not independently verified.
Consumer Reports ranked-product content remains missing; source free-access declarations remain false.
No new native regression suite, actual SDK, credentials/passkeys, media or interactive acceptance gate.
Extraction-only timing excludes load/network and does not establish general browser performance.
